static_traits.name: 李若薇
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；not yet接受过心理治疗；既往not yet出现类似心理问题的治疗史
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, positive attitude, highly cooperative; self-reports slight tension; willing to observe and record as suggested

basic_info.main_problem: 我有一种观念：我之所以喜欢健身，是因为我从小就害怕因任何与健康有关的问题而Death，现在只能通过锻炼来平复自己。这一信念影响了我对健身的享受，并可能影响我的整体心理健康。
basic_info.core_demands: 我想打破这种恐惧的循环，能够在have not持续担忧和Anxiety的情况下享受锻炼。
growth_experiences: 童年时期家庭对健康与健身高度重视，父母常担心疾病并督促全家‘做一切保持健康的事’；来访者逐渐将家人的健康Anxiety内化为自身信念，长期存在对健康相关Death的担忧，这种恐惧一直在背景中伴随，近两年更加明显。

core_beliefs: 我的健康随时面临威胁
只有通过严格锻炼才能保持安全

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not通过锻炼来控制健康，就会生病甚至Death
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Using exercise as the main way of soothing, increasing training frequency and intensity to reduce fear

special_situations.event: 错过一次训练或觉得自己have not足够用力的时候
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我错过一次或强度not够，就意味着我对健康not负责任，风险会显著上升
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Strictly follows a high-standard training plan, avoiding any absence or reduced intensity
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: not能有一次松懈，否则健康会快速恶化

special_situations.event: When family or others talk about health, illness, and the importance of staying healthy
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not按家人的健康标准行事，就会not安全、容易生病
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 内化并遵循家人的健康规则与期待
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我应该照着他们的标准去做

special_situations.event: 在日常生活中出现与健康风险相关的Anxiety或担忧时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not立刻锻炼，Anxiety会失控并危害健康
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 立刻进行运动以平复情绪和获得安全感
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 只有锻炼才能让我安全和冷静

core_conflict.wish: 渴望获得安全与掌控（免受疾病和Death的威胁）
defense_goal: 通过严格坚持锻炼来维持安全感并降低Anxiety
Avoiding relaxing or being absent to reduce the fear of being threatened by illness

object_relations.self_representation: 需要时刻警惕、易受健康威胁的个体
object_relations.object_representation: Worried caregivers / supervisors (parents) who demand strictness

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor explores the origins of fear and the family's influence on health
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将咨询师的Questioning理解为需要提供理性解释与事实，而非进入情绪体验（倾向以思考替代感受）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use平静、描述性语言，聚焦事实与解释，减少情感词汇；语气温和但保持一定距离。

manifestations: 从很小就害怕因健康问题而Death
将锻炼视为避免Death与疾病的手段
在锻炼中not断担心健康风险、把健身当成逃避恐惧的方式
近两年恐惧更突出，Reduced sense of enjoyment
outcomes: 强迫性/僵化的锻炼模式

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Treats the family's health rules as personal standards that must be followed
以“not能错过一次训练”“必须足够用力”的自我要求面对健身

positive_force: 具备稳定的运动习惯与行动力
对问题有自我觉察并主动寻求咨询支持
愿意尝试记录与行为实验，态度积极
negative_force: 非黑即白的自我要求与标准
将外界健康规则Introjection为自我规范，依赖外部标准获得安全感
过度依赖锻炼来缓解Anxiety，限制了灵活性与享受

target_behavior.behavior: Using exercise as the only way of self-soothing, compulsively persisting with high intensity and high frequency
antecedent: 错过一次训练或强度not足
target_behavior.core_reason: 早期家庭对健康的高度关注促成内化信念“若not严格锻炼就会生病/Death”，伴随灾难化Anticipation与非黑即白标准
target_behavior.function: 逃避Anxiety与感知到的健康风险，获得短期安全感与情绪缓解
target_behavior.consequence: 锻炼的乐趣显著下降，身心疲惫；Anxiety-锻炼的负性循环被Reinforcement，Overall well-being impaired
